title: Publication of Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions Regulations Web General Licenses 55F and 115D
text: Publication of Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions Regulations Web General Licenses 55F and 115D (Treasury Department, Foreign Assets Control Office).
